mapper.sql: select tlocation.id, tlocation.code, tlocation.name, tlocation.area_id, tlocation.reservoir_id, tlocation.category_id, tlocation.deposit_category_id, tlocation.unit_id, tlocation.same_material_flag, tlocation.same_batch_flag, tlocation.upper_limit, tlocation.location_row, tlocation.location_column, tlocation.location_plies, tlocation.goods_allocation_status, tlocation.status, tlocation.location_type, tlocation.pallet_num, tlocation.remark, tlocation.create_by, tlocation.create_time, tlocation.update_by, tlocation.update_time, tlocation.dept_id, tlocation.dept_name, tlocation.del_flag ,tlocation.extention_frist_id,tlocation.extention_type,tlocation.pallet_node_id from t_location tlocation
mapper.delete: update t_location set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_location set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and area_id = #{areaId} and goods_allocation_status = '1' and ifnull(pallet_num, '') = ''

SELECT tll.id,IFNULL(tll.`code`,'') as code,tll.name,tll.location_row as locationRow,tll.location_column as locationColumn, tll.location_plies as locationPlies,tll.goods_allocation_status as goodsAllocationStatus,tll.`status`, IFNULL(tll.pallet_num,'') as palletNum,IFNULL(ts.is_freeze,0) as isFreeze FROM t_location tll LEFT JOIN (SELECT location_id,is_freeze from t_stock WHERE del_flag='0' GROUP BY location_id,is_freeze ) ts on ts.location_id=tll.id WHERE tll.del_flag='0' AND tll.location_row=#{locationRow} AND tll.reservoir_id=#{reservoirId} AND tll.location_type='0' ORDER BY tll.location_plies ASC

SELECT tm.`code`,tm.`name`,tsm.library_count as `count`,tsm.available_count as availableCount,t.id as stockId,t.material_id as materialId,tu.`name` as unitName FROM t_stock t INNER JOIN t_material tm on t.material_id=tm.id AND tm.del_flag='0' INNER JOIN t_stock_main tsm on tsm.material_id=tm.id AND tm.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN t_unit tu on tu.id=tm.unit_id WHERE t.location_id=#{locationId} AND t.del_flag='0'

SELECT CONCAT(IFNULL(tl.location_row ,''),'','排') as locationRowName,IFNULL(tl.location_row ,'') as locationRow FROM t_location tl WHERE tl.reservoir_id=#{reservoirId} AND tl.del_flag='0' GROUP BY tl.location_row
mapper.update: update t_location set good_shelf_id = null where id = #{tLocation.id}
mapper.select: select a.name areaName, r.name reservoirName, gs.name goodShelfName, l.name locationName, count(case sd.type when '1' then 1 else null end) inCount, count(case sd.type when '2' then 1 else null end) outCount from t_location l left join t_good_shelf gs on l.good_shelf_id=gs.id left join t_reservoir r on l.reservoir_id=r.id left join t_area a on l.area_id=a.id left join t_stock_detail sd on l.id=sd.location_id and sd.del_flag='0' and sd.type in('1','2') where l.del_flag='0' and l.area_id = #{areaId} and l.reservoir_id = #{reservoirId} group by l.id order by l.id desc

select a.name areaName, l.id, r.name reservoirName, gs.name goodShelfName, l.name locationName, l.goods_allocation_status goodsAllocationStatus, l.update_by updateBy, l.update_time updateTime, count(s.id) stockCount from t_location l left join t_good_shelf gs on l.good_shelf_id=gs.id left join t_reservoir r on l.reservoir_id=r.id left join t_area a on l.area_id=a.id left join t_stock s on l.id=s.location_id and s.del_flag='0' where l.del_flag='0' and l.area_id=#{areaId} and l.reservoir_id=#{reservoirId} and l.id=#{locationId} group by l.id order by l.id desc

select tl2.* from t_location tl inner join t_location tl2 on tl.location_plies = tl2.location_plies where tl.id = #{trayId} and tl.del_flag = '0' and tl2.del_flag = '0' and tl2.pallet_node_id = #{tempPallet} limit 1
